type_property_additions.evidence_source: 1C vendor standard v8std #std742 (https://its.1c.ru/db/v8std#content:742): the managed-form window mode is set as `РежимОткрытияОкна = БлокироватьОкноВладельца`.
type_property_additions.rationale: shcntx_ru.hbk files this writable managed-form property under its enum type name (FormWindowOpeningMode / РежимОткрытияОкнаФормы), so the extracted data lacks ClientApplicationForm.РежимОткрытияОкна and the unused-local check reports every `РежимОткрытияОкна = …` form-context write as a dead local.

type_property_corrections.name: Значение
type_property_corrections.evidence_source: ISSUE #230: a runtime probe on platform 8.3.27.2214 — `Область = ТабДок.ТекущаяОбласть; Область.Значение = 5;` is refused at run time with «Поле объекта недоступно для записи (Значение)». The extracted record of ОбластьЯчеекТабличногоДокумента.Значение (property id 12748) carries `is_readonly: false`; the same flag is false in the legacy `platform_data.json` of releases before v0.3.0 (the file left the tree with #312), so this is a data gap and not a regression of the dump.
type_property_corrections.rationale: The help page of ОбластьЯчеекТабличногоДокумента.Значение omits the read-only mark the runtime enforces, so every `Обл.Значение = …` on a range is accepted silently by the analyzer although the assignment can never succeed — the value of a range belongs to the document that computed it. ReadOnlyPropertyAssignment has to answer for this property as it does for Запрос.Параметры.

type_property_corrections.name: СочетаниеКлавиш
type_property_corrections.evidence_source: Run on platforms 8.3.17.1549 and 8.3.27.2214 (file infobase, compatibility mode 8.3.17 and none): `Кнопка.СочетаниеКлавиш = Новый СочетаниеКлавиш(Клавиша.F7)` (client and server, a button from the form description and one added by `Элементы.Добавить`) is accepted and the new value is read back; a control assignment to a read-only property in the same run fails with «Поле объекта недоступно для записи».
type_property_corrections.rationale: shcntx_ru.hbk marks the property «Использование: Только чтение», so ReadOnlyPropertyAssignment reports a write the platform performs. The help itself says the shortcut runs the button's command; setting it at run time is the usual way to give a generated button a key.

type_property_corrections.rationale: shcntx_ru.hbk marks the property «Использование: Только чтение», so ReadOnlyPropertyAssignment reports a write the platform performs. Ordinary forms switch the selection mode of a table box at run time.

method_return_type_corrections.name: Создать
method_return_type_corrections.evidence_source: A runtime probe on platforms 8.3.17.1549 and 8.3.27.2214 (server code, a factory built from an XML schema with one complex and one simple type, and the global ФабрикаXDTO): `ТипЗнч(Ф.Создать(<ТипОбъектаXDTO>))` is «Объект XDTO» and equals `Тип("ОбъектXDTO")`; `ТипЗнч(Ф.Создать(<ТипЗначенияXDTO>, "x"))` is «Значение XDTO»; `ФабрикаXDTO.Создать(ФабрикаXDTO.Тип("http://v8.1c.ru/8.1/data/core", "TypeDescription"))` is «Объект XDTO». The extracted record (method id 2070) lists the variant «Создание объекта» with a `ТипОбъектаXDTO` parameter but carries `return_type: ЗначениеXDTO` for every variant.
method_return_type_corrections.rationale: With `ЗначениеXDTO` alone every object created by the factory is typed as a value, and a write to a property of the object that is spelled like a property of ЗначениеXDTO (`Объект.Значение = …`, `Объект.Value = …`) is reported as ReadOnlyPropertyAssignment although the platform accepts it. The call returns one of the two types depending on the kind of its `Тип` argument, so the result is their union; a write to `Значение` of a value that is known to be a ЗначениеXDTO (an element of `Список`, for instance) is still reported.

type_member_surface_attestations.evidence_source: The pinned 8.3.27 corpus (PROVENANCE.md) documents ОбластьЯчеекТабличногоДокумента with 8 methods (ids 6361-6368) and 63 properties (ids 12690-12752); platform_facts.json holds exactly those records, each with its own execution contexts and minimum version (one property, ЭлементУправления, carries no value-type list in the extract, which says nothing about the member list). The type is not one of the 57 corpus types the extract records with neither a method nor a property, its name is unique (ОбластьЯчеекТабличногоДокумента / SpreadsheetDocumentRange resolve to one type), and no docs-gap overlay of crates/bsl-platform/src/db.rs synthesizes or withholds a member of it — the only synthesized member in the corpus belongs to XMLStringProcessingManager.
type_member_surface_attestations.rationale: An absent-member check on a platform type is only sound where the extract is known to list the whole surface: for the 57 types the extract records with neither a method nor a property, and for the types the docs-gap overlays patch, a miss proves nothing. SpreadsheetDocumentRange is neither, so its 71 extracted members are the platform's own surface at 8.3.27 and a miss on a receiver of it is a defect of the checked code.

type_member_surface_attestations.evidence_source: The pinned 8.3.27 corpus documents ЗаписьJSON / JSONWriter with 11 methods (ids 4602-4612: УстановитьСтроку, ОткрытьФайл, ОткрытьПоток, ЗаписатьНачалоМассива, ЗаписатьКонецМассива, ЗаписатьЗначение, ЗаписатьИмяСвойства, ЗаписатьНачалоОбъекта, ЗаписатьКонецОбъекта, ЗаписатьБезОбработки, Закрыть) and 2 properties (ids 9550-9551: Параметры, ПроверятьСтруктуру); platform_facts.json holds exactly these 13 records, and the published syntax assistant of 8.3 names the same eleven methods. The type is not among the corpus types without members, its name is unique (ЗаписьJSON / JSONWriter resolve to one type), and no docs-gap overlay of crates/bsl-platform/src/db.rs covers it.
type_member_surface_attestations.rationale: JSON is written through the object/array/value members the extract lists; there is no table-level member, so a call like `Запись.ЗаписатьНачалоТаблицы()` is a call the platform does not answer. Attesting the 13 members makes the method-miss check able to say so, where before the receiver was a PlatformObject with an unjudgeable surface.

type_member_surface_attestations.evidence_source: The pinned 8.3.27 corpus documents ТаблицаЗначений / ValueTable with 19 methods (ids 1817-1835: Удалить, Сортировать, Скопировать, Сдвинуть, Получить, Очистить, НайтиСтроки, Количество, ЗаполнитьЗначения, Итог, Найти, ЗагрузитьКолонку, ВыбратьСтроку, Вставить, ВыгрузитьКолонку, СкопироватьКолонки, Добавить, Индекс, Свернуть) and 2 properties (ids 5519-5520: Колонки, Индексы); platform_facts.json holds exactly these 21 records. The type is not among the corpus types without members, its name is unique (ТаблицаЗначений / ValueTable resolve to one type), and no docs-gap overlay of crates/bsl-platform/src/db.rs covers it. A live run on 8.3.17.1549 and 8.3.27.2214 answers `Таблица.НетТакогоМетода()` on `Новый ТаблицаЗначений` with «Метод объекта не обнаружен (НетТакогоМетода)» and `Таблица.НетТакогоПоля` with «Поле объекта не обнаружено (НетТакогоПоля)», while `Колонки.Добавить`, `Добавить` and `Количество()` work.
type_member_surface_attestations.rationale: A value table's columns are members of its rows, not of the table, so the table's own surface is the platform's 21 members whatever columns it carries. Attesting them lets the method-miss and field-miss checks judge a table the walk saw built by `Новый ТаблицаЗначений` on every path, where before the receiver was a kind of its own with no surface the checks could close.

type_member_surface_attestations.evidence_source: The pinned 8.3.27 corpus documents КоллекцияРисунковТабличногоДокумента / SpreadsheetDocumentDrawingCollection with exactly 6 methods (ids 6355-6360: Удалить, Очистить, Получить, Количество, Добавить, Индекс) and no property; platform_facts.json holds exactly these records. The type is not among the corpus types without members, its name is unique, and no docs-gap overlay of crates/bsl-platform/src/db.rs covers it. The collection addresses its elements by name, so an element name is answered as a property, which is why only the method surface is attested. A live run on 8.3.17.1549 and 8.3.27.2214 finds no method `Найти` on the collection, measured live, while `ТабДок.Рисунки.<имя рисунка>` resolves to the drawing of that name.
type_member_surface_attestations.rationale: The collection has no property of its own, and a name read from it is the name of an element, not a miss in the extract: attesting the property surface would make the absent-field check report every element name. The method list is the platform's own, so a call like `Рисунки.Найти(...)` is a call the platform does not answer, and the method-miss check may say so. The field surface is deliberately left unattested.
